# Workflow catalog

<!-- generated by `python -m omi workflows`; do not edit -->
- omi-flow-bugfix: Fix a defect at its root cause: failing test first, root-cause fix across all callers, regression test, independent review, PO acceptance. Use for a reported bug with a reproducible symptom; use feature for new behaviour. [plan > reproduce > fix > review > accept] [~675 tokens]
- omi-flow-feature-sensitive: Feature touching auth, secrets, permissions, data, CI or the agent harness: architect design first, then implement, review, security review, PO acceptance. Use only for that risk; plain feature is enough otherwise. [plan > architect > build > review > security > accept] [~592 tokens]
- omi-flow-feature-ui: Feature with a UI change: UI spec first, then implement, review, browser QA with screenshots, PO acceptance. Use when screens or interaction change; plain feature is enough for backend or non-visual work. [plan > design > build > review > qa > accept] [~568 tokens]
- omi-flow-feature: Default build path for one product change: plan, implement, independent review, PO acceptance. Use for any normal feature or fix; use feature-ui if the UI changes, feature-sensitive for auth, secrets, data or CI. [plan > build > review > accept] [~487 tokens]
- omi-flow-refactor: Restructure code without changing behaviour: tests green before, change, tests green after, independent simplify review, PO acceptance. Use when behaviour must stay identical; use bugfix or feature if behaviour changes. [plan > baseline > refactor > review > accept] [~655 tokens]
